description: This file provides functions for interacting with user-related API endpoints in a web application's frontend. It includes functions to fetch user data, projects, batch project info, and session details, along with a utility to wrap ISO date strings for MongoDB queries.

methods.name: wrapIsoAsMongoISODate(iso)
methods.description: Wraps an ISO string into a Mongo-shell style ISODate("...") expression for endpoint queries that expect ISODate-wrapped timestamps.

methods.name: getUserBasic(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a single user document by ID from the API endpoint. Throws an error if userId is not provided.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {}, options = {})
methods.description: Fetches distinct project list for a user, with optional time range and tenant scoping. Uses wrapIsoAsMongoISODate for date formatting.

methods.name: getUsersProjectsBatch(body = {}, options = {})
methods.description: Fetches project info for multiple users in a single batch request. Accepts an array of user IDs and optional scoping parameters.

methods.name: getUserSessionDetails(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Retrieves aggregated session details for a user, such as total count and duration.
